reading: Waymo has stopped its driverless taxis from using US freeways for now.
Driverless taxis carry passengers without a human driver.
Freeways are large roads for fast traffic.
California banned the taxis from its freeways after several traffic problems.
Some Waymo cars entered areas where people were working on the road.
California officials said the cars were a danger to people in these areas.
Waymo said there were no reports of anyone being hurt in the incident near San Francisco.
Waymo said it was working with state officials to start freeway trips again.
The taxis can still carry passengers on normal city streets.

vocabulary.definition: People who travel in a car, bus or train but do not drive it.
Said officially that something was not allowed.

entries.ja: 人間の運転手がいない。
車やバス、電車に乗って移動するが、その乗り物を運転しない人たち。
entries.ko: 자동차, 버스 또는 기차를 타고 이동하지만 그 교통수단을 운전하지는 않는 사람들.
entries.zh-Hans: 乘坐汽车、公共汽车或火车出行，但不驾驶这些交通工具的人。
entries.es: Personas que viajan en un automóvil, autobús o tren, pero no lo conducen.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas que viajam de carro, ônibus ou trem, mas não conduzem esses veículos.
entries.fr: Personnes qui voyagent dans une voiture, un bus ou un train, mais ne conduisent pas ce véhicule.
entries.de: Menschen, die in einem Auto, Bus oder Zug mitfahren, das Fahrzeug aber nicht selbst fahren.

entries.ja: 車が速く走るための大きな道路。
entries.ko: 차량이 빠르게 다니도록 만든 큰 도로들.
entries.zh-Hans: 供车辆快速行驶的大型道路。
entries.es: Carreteras grandes para que los vehículos circulen a alta velocidad.
entries.pt-BR: Estradas grandes para o tráfego de veículos em alta velocidade.
entries.fr: Grandes routes destinées à la circulation rapide des véhicules.

entries.ja: 何かが許されないと正式に表明した。
entries.ko: 어떤 것이 허용되지 않는다고 공식적으로 밝혔다.
entries.zh-Hans: 正式宣布某事不被允许。
entries.es: Declaró oficialmente que algo no estaba permitido.
entries.pt-BR: Declarou oficialmente que algo não era permitido.
entries.fr: A déclaré officiellement que quelque chose n’était pas autorisé.
entries.de: Erklärte offiziell, dass etwas nicht erlaubt war.

entries.ja: ある場所の中に入った。
